title: MIX08 Microsoft Office 2007: The Story of the Ribbon (1 of 10)
summary: Jensen Harris of the Office 2007 design team tells the behind-the-scenes story of the Ribbon at MIX08. He covers early prototypes, mistakes, and the UX principles used to design and validate it.
why: HN points to it to explain the design rationale behind the Ribbon and why the older menu and toolbar interface had accumulated too much cruft.

quote.text: he certainly made a good case for how the older interface had accumulated way too much cruft
